ticket_text: My password expired and I cannot log in to the company portal.
resolution: Reset password and verify account access.

ticket_text: I forgot my VPN password and need access from home.
resolution: Reset VPN credentials and verify MFA.

ticket_text: My account is locked after several incorrect login attempts.
resolution: Unlock the account and verify authentication.

ticket_text: I keep getting an invalid credentials message when signing in.
resolution: Verify credentials and account status.

ticket_text: Please grant me access to the finance application.
resolution: Verify approval and provision requested access.

ticket_text: I need permission to access the shared HR folder.
resolution: Check authorization and update folder permissions.

ticket_text: My laptop will not turn on this morning.
resolution: Check power, adapter, battery and hardware diagnostics.

ticket_text: The laptop screen is flickering and goes black randomly.
resolution: Run display diagnostics and inspect hardware connections.

ticket_text: My keyboard is not responding to several keys.
resolution: Reconnect or replace the keyboard and test the device.

ticket_text: The office printer is not printing my documents.
resolution: Check printer connectivity, queue and device status.

ticket_text: My laptop became extremely slow after the latest Windows update.
resolution: Review recent updates and system resource utilization.

ticket_text: The system takes several minutes to open applications.
resolution: Check startup processes, resource usage and disk health.

ticket_text: Excel crashes every time I open a large workbook.
resolution: Check application logs, add-ins and compatibility.

ticket_text: Outlook closes immediately after I launch it.
resolution: Repair the application profile and inspect crash logs.

ticket_text: The Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting in the meeting room.
resolution: Check access-point connectivity, signal and interference.

ticket_text: I cannot connect to the office wireless network.
resolution: Verify wireless credentials and access-point availability.

ticket_text: VPN connects but I cannot reach internal applications.
resolution: Check VPN routing, DNS and internal access.

ticket_text: The VPN connection drops every few minutes.
resolution: Review VPN logs, network stability and client configuration.

ticket_text: Emails are not syncing on my phone.
resolution: Verify mailbox synchronization and connectivity.

ticket_text: Outlook is not receiving new emails.
resolution: Check mailbox status and synchronization.

ticket_text: I received a suspicious email asking for my password.
resolution: Report the message and investigate phishing indicators.

ticket_text: This email contains a strange link and looks like phishing.
resolution: Analyze the message and block malicious indicators if confirmed.

ticket_text: My computer may have malware because unknown programs appeared.
resolution: Isolate the endpoint and run security investigation.

ticket_text: Antivirus reported a possible malicious file on my laptop.
resolution: Quarantine the file and investigate the endpoint.

ticket_text: I need a new application installed for my project.
resolution: Verify approval and install the required application.

ticket_text: Please install the latest approved version of the reporting tool.
resolution: Confirm approval and deploy requested software.

ticket_text: My password reset link is not working.
resolution: Issue a new reset link and verify account recovery.

ticket_text: I cannot sign into the payroll system.
resolution: Verify account status, credentials and application access.

ticket_text: The monitor connected to my workstation has no display.
resolution: Check cable connections, input source and monitor power.

ticket_text: The printer shows an offline status.
resolution: Check printer network connection and device status.

ticket_text: My laptop is freezing during normal work.
resolution: Check CPU, memory, disk utilization and recent changes.

ticket_text: The accounting application crashes when I generate a report.
resolution: Inspect application logs and reproduce the crash.

ticket_text: Network access is unavailable on my desktop.
resolution: Check physical connectivity, DHCP and network availability.

ticket_text: The internet is very slow across the office.
resolution: Check network utilization, routing and service health.

ticket_text: I cannot access the shared drive through VPN.
resolution: Verify VPN tunnel, routing and shared-drive access.

ticket_text: I accidentally clicked a suspicious attachment.
resolution: Isolate the endpoint and inspect security indicators.

ticket_text: My mailbox is full and I cannot receive messages.
resolution: Review mailbox quota and archive unnecessary messages.

ticket_text: I need access to the project email group.
resolution: Verify approval and add the user to the authorized group.

ticket_text: The company laptop battery drains very quickly.
resolution: Check battery health and power-management settings.

ticket_text: A critical business application is down for the whole team.
resolution: Escalate immediately and investigate service availability.

ticket_text: I cannot connect to Wi-Fi after changing my password.
resolution: Reconnect the wireless profile and verify credentials.

ticket_text: My Outlook calendar is not updating.
resolution: Check account synchronization and client connectivity.

ticket_text: Please give me access to the development repository.
resolution: Verify approval and provision repository access.

ticket_text: The laptop fan is running constantly and everything is slow.
resolution: Check thermal conditions, CPU usage and hardware health.

ticket_text: A security alert says a suspicious process is running.
resolution: Isolate the endpoint and investigate the suspicious process.

ticket_text: I cannot print to the finance department printer.
resolution: Check printer queue, permissions and connectivity.

ticket_text: The browser crashes whenever I open the internal dashboard.
resolution: Check browser extensions, cache and compatibility.

ticket_text: VPN authentication fails even though my password is correct.
resolution: Verify VPN authentication, MFA and client configuration.

ticket_text: I received a message requesting confidential company information.
resolution: Report and investigate the message for phishing indicators.

ticket_text: My desktop has no network connection.
resolution: Check Ethernet connection, adapter and DHCP.

ticket_text: Laptop became slow after Windows update and applications take longer to open.
resolution: Review recent updates and system resource utilization.

ticket_text: Suspicious email asks me to click a link and enter my password.
resolution: Report the message and investigate phishing indicators.

ticket_text: Cannot connect to the office Wi-Fi in the conference room.
resolution: Verify wireless credentials and access-point availability.

ticket_text: Outlook does not receive new messages on my computer.
resolution: Check mailbox status and synchronization.

ticket_text: My account is locked and I cannot sign in.
resolution: Unlock the account and verify authentication.
